signals.text: 4 open PM roles across 1 US office

roles.title: Director of Agent Product Management, Mid-Market Accounts

bullets: Lead and scale the APM and ASM teams serving Mid-Market customers, and own the hiring bar, team structure, and career development as volume grows.
Own the Mid-Market launch process: standard scoping, templates, configuration approach, and time-to-launch targets.
Own portfolio performance across many accounts, including launch speed, agent performance, abandonment, hold time, conversion, and staffing capacity, and build the reviews and…
Model capacity across many concurrent launches and make the call when demand exceeds what the team can take on.
Decide what gets standardized. When the same customer request keeps coming up, work with Product and Engineering to turn it into a standard capability.

roles.title: Director of Agent Product Management, Enterprise & Strategic Accounts

bullets: Lead and scale the APM and ASM teams serving Enterprise and Strategic accounts, and own the hiring bar, team structure, and career development as the function grows.
Serve as the executive owner for your largest accounts, working directly with customer VP and C-suite stakeholders and leading the hard conversations yourself.
Own the rollout plan for each account: sequencing, capacity, dependencies, and the tradeoffs when a customer wants more than the team can deliver.
Own portfolio performance, including time-to-launch, agent performance, abandonment, hold time, conversion, and staffing capacity, and catch systemic risk before it becomes an…
Step into the most complex deployments and escalations yourself and lead from the front.
Lead complex, multi-stakeholder customer implementations autonomously — including new specialties, new products, and multi-site rollouts
Own strategic customer relationships during implementation end-to-end, including navigating challenging conversations and setting clear expectations
Identify high-impact product improvements by analyzing user behavior and customer outcomes; define, partner with eng/product to action, and measure results
Build new scalable processes, best practices, and systems from scratch — not just improving what exists, but creating infrastructure that outlasts your direct involvement
Drive automation and efficiency across the team by designing and implementing tools, workflows, and systems that reduce operational burden
Lead customer onboarding and implementations autonomously
Directly manage and resolve customer feedback and issues in a manner consistent with our company values.
Identify product improvements and new product offerings to better support our customers and expand our impact
Drive automation and scalable processes by building and refining internal tools, systems, and workflows that improve efficiency and support rapid growth.
Operate autonomously to develop processes and strategy from scratch.
